# 般若心經註解

**ID:** X0575
**Volume:** X26
**Category:** 般若部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／般若部疏
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0575

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle anonymous mid-Míng (post-Zhèngtǒng) Heart Sūtra commentary compilation, drawing on the earlier commentaries attributed to Dàdiān 大顛 ([寶通](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E9%80%9A) Bǎotōng, [KR6c0192](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0192)) and Wúgòu 無垢 ([何道全](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%95%E9%81%93%E5%85%A8) Hé Dàoquán, [KR6c0193](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0193)) and adding fresh material from a Zhèngtǒng-era (1436–1449) patriarch and a Jīnlíng *jūshì* tradition. Preserved in the Wàn xùzàng / *Manji zoku-zō* as X575. Two fascicles. The catalog meta lists no author; the work is essentially anonymous.

**Abstract**

X575 is an anonymous mid-Míng compilation that explicitly continues the *Quánzhēn* Daoist *sānjiào héyī* Heart Sūtra commentary tradition of [何道全](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%95%E9%81%93%E5%85%A8) Hé Dàoquán (X574 = [KR6c0193](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0193)). The reference to the Zhèngtǒng-era *wúzǔ* (my patriarch) — without explicit naming — is evasive; the patriarch is most likely a senior *Quánzhēn* Daoist master of the mid-fifteenth century, whose work the disciples did not name explicitly to avoid attracting hostile imperial attention.

The mention of the Jīnlíng *Yùjīng dàorén Chéng Qíngshòu* (or perhaps to be read 彭澤金陵遇經道人 or similar — the precise punctuation is uncertain) suggests a parallel transmission line in the Jīnlíng region. Together these references build a picture of a mid-Míng *Quánzhēn*-and-Buddhist syncretic network committed to producing accessible Heart Sūtra commentaries with *sānjiào héyī* methodology.

The verse-images-verse opening — and the explicit reference to a now-lost illustration — suggests the original was a richly illustrated woodblock print, characteristic of the mid-Míng *jiǎngjīng* (popular sūtra-explanation) genre that flourished alongside the *bǎojuǎn* 寶卷 (precious-scroll) literature of the same period.

For the wider history of Heart Sūtra commentary, X575 is a primary witness to the mid-Míng popular *sānjiào héyī* commentary tradition that connected the late-Yuán *Quánzhēn* commentary culture ([何道全](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%95%E9%81%93%E5%85%A8) Hé Dàoquán) with the late-Wànlì *Sānyī jiào* movement ([林兆恩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9E%97%E5%85%86%E6%81%A9) Lín Zhàoēn). It documents the continuous transmission of *sānjiào* hermeneutical methods through the fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries.

Composition date: post-Zhèngtǒng (1449) by the preface's reference; no firmer dating evidence. The bracket *notBefore* 1450 / *notAfter* 1550 reflects this conservative window.
